info.name: Esport API - Local Integration Tests
info.description: Sequential integration tests for all implemented API endpoints. Creates temporary users, teams, tournament, and match, exercises protected operations, and cleans up generated data at the end. Set adminUsername and adminPassword to an existing admin account before running.

exec: pm.test('Registrasi captain berhasil dan tidak membocorkan password', function () {

pm.test('User ketiga berhasil didaftarkan tanpa membocorkan password', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data.username).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('thirdUsername')); pm.expect(body.data).not.to.have.property('password'); pm.collectionVariables.set('thirdId', String(body.data.id)); });

item.name: 2b. Reject protected mutation with invalid token

exec: pm.test('Mutasi dengan token tidak valid ditolak', function () {

item.name: 13b. Reject registration when tournament is full

exec: pm.test('Pendaftaran ditolak saat kuota turnamen penuh', function () {
pm.test('Pendaftaran ganda ditolak dan dikembalikan sebagai conflict', function () {

pm.test('Daftar pertandingan memuat Alpha vs Beta', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; const match = data.find(item => item.team1_name === pm.collectionVariables.get('teamAlpha') && item.team2_name === pm.collectionVariables.get('teamBeta')); pm.expect(match, 'pertandingan Alpha vs Beta').to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set('matchId', String(match.id)); });
pm.test('Format jadwal salah ditolak dengan 400', function () {
pm.test('Admin dapat mencatat pemenang pertandingan', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('message'); });

pm.test('Jadwal menampilkan waktu dan pemenang', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const match = pm.response.json().data.find(item => item.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('matchId'))); pm.expect(match).to.exist; pm.expect(match.winner_name).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('teamAlpha')); pm.expect(match.status).to.eql('completed'); pm.expect(match.schedule_time).to.include('2026-10-14 19:30:00'); });
